description: Complete official PDFs cited by ChipSim architecture examples, reviewed document profiles, and data-derived function-table tests. Versions are pinned snapshots.

documents.title: RP2040 Datasheet
documents.supports: Instruction memory, state machines, FIFOs, shifts, pin control, and instruction behavior.
documents.model_assumptions: The model combines multiple instructions into semantic actions. FIFO delay, bounded polling, and normalized timing are model choices; WAIT alone is not a timeout.

documents.title: AM335x and AMIC110 Sitara Processors Technical Reference Manual
documents.supports: PRU execution and the direct R30/R31 I/O paths.
documents.model_assumptions: Only direct-output mode is modeled. Four ticks of unavailable firmware represent a teaching experiment; detailed instruction timing, bus arbitration, and optional shift-output hardware are outside scope.

documents.title: Using FlexIO to emulate communications and timing peripherals
documents.relevant_sections: 2 Overview of the FlexIO module; 4.1.1 transmit configuration
documents.supports: Shifter/timer structure, triggers, and transfer configuration.
documents.model_assumptions: The example uses a representative S32K144 resource budget. Register encodings, buffer aliases, and automatic framing are abstracted; custom ACK handling is host software.

documents.title: PSoC 5LP Architecture TRM
documents.relevant_sections: 21 Universal Digital Blocks; 22 UDB Array and Digital System Interconnect
documents.supports: PLDs, datapaths, configuration stores, and routing.
documents.model_assumptions: The design is a composed UDB network, not a claim that the complete link fits one UDB. Fitting, propagation delay, and exact clock distribution are abstracted.

documents.title: The XMOS XS3 Architecture
documents.relevant_sections: 3 Concurrent Threads; 5 Instruction Issue and Execution; 10 Resources and the Thread Scheduler; 14 Timers; 15 Ports, Input and Output; 17 Events
documents.supports: Execution sharing, resource-driven scheduling, timed ports, timers, and event handling.
documents.model_assumptions: The model allows one pending unbuffered timed write. Displayed CLK is a data bit, distinct from the underlying port clock. Time domains and counter wrap are abstracted.

documents.title: AN03001: XCORE Clocked Input and Output
documents.relevant_sections: 1 Generating a Clock Signal; 3 Performing I/O on Specific Clock Edges; 5 Summary of Clocked Port Behavior
documents.supports: Port clock configuration and I/O timing conditions.
documents.model_assumptions: This supports the port timing explanation; it is not the executable implementation of ChipSim's DATA/CLK/ACK recipe.

documents.title: Understanding the eTPU Channel Hardware
documents.supports: Match/capture action units, pin actions, recognition control, event latches, and servicing.
documents.model_assumptions: CLK rearming is modeled with two slots. Separate DATA-channel preparation is assumed timely. A missed required CLK target ends the demonstration rather than predicting every later hardware effect.

documents.title: The Essentials of Enhanced Time Processing Unit
documents.supports: Shared microengine, memory, channels, and hardware-assisted timing.
documents.model_assumptions: ACK capture is evaluated by its timestamp, with a model-defined two-tick service delay. These timing constants are teaching assumptions, not device latency specifications.

documents.title: 74HC595; 74HCT595 product data sheet
documents.relevant_sections: 1 General description; 5 Functional diagram; 6.2 Pin description; 7 Functional description, Table 3
documents.supports: Eight-stage shifting, independent storage clock, active-low shift reset, simultaneous clock ordering, and output gating.
documents.model_assumptions: Ideal digital steps; configured initial values are scenario choices, not guaranteed power-on state. Parallel latch value and output-enable flag are represented separately; analog high impedance, propagation delays, and setup/hold constraints are omitted.

documents.title: 74HC00; 74HCT00 product data sheet
documents.supports: Binary combinational function table and numbered gate instances. These are regression references, not fingerprint-specific compiler rules.
documents.model_assumptions: Ideal instantaneous binary logic. Indexed channels are derived from pin lists; electrical and timing behavior is omitted.

documents.title: 74HC86; 74HCT86 product data sheet
documents.supports: Binary combinational function table and numbered gate instances. These are regression references, not fingerprint-specific compiler rules.
documents.model_assumptions: Ideal instantaneous binary logic. Indexed channels are derived from pin lists; electrical and timing behavior is omitted.

documents.title: 74HC157; 74HCT157 product data sheet
documents.supports: Four independent data channels using shared select and enable pins, derived from the binary table and pin descriptions. Regression reference, not a fingerprint-specific compiler rule.
documents.model_assumptions: Ideal instantaneous binary logic; normalized ticks, no electrical or propagation-delay model.

documents.title: 74HC377; 74HCT377 product data sheet
documents.supports: Eight independent retained output bits with shared clock and enable; edge loading and explicit no-change rows derived from table content. Regression reference, not a fingerprint-specific rule.
documents.model_assumptions: Configured initial output bits are scenario values, not specified power-on state. Tick zero establishes clock history; ideal edge evaluation omits physical setup/hold constraints, metastability, electrical characteristics, and delays.

documents.title: 74HC273; 74HCT273 product data sheet
documents.relevant_sections: 5.2 Pin description on PDF page 3; 6 Functional description, Table 3 on PDF page 4
documents.supports: Eight retained output bits with shared clock and asynchronous reset; reset dominance and edge loading derived from table content. Regression reference, not a fingerprint-specific rule.
documents.model_assumptions: Configured initial output bits are scenario values, not specified power-on state. Tick zero establishes clock history; ideal edge evaluation omits physical setup/hold constraints, metastability, electrical characteristics, and delays.

documents.title: SN74LVC1G125 Single Bus Buffer Gate With 3-State Output
documents.relevant_sections: 7.4 Device Functional Modes, Table 7-1 and its input/output symbol footnotes on PDF page 11
documents.supports: One buffer with binary data/enable inputs and explicit high-impedance output. Regression reference; behavior is compiled from table content, without a fingerprint-specific rule.
documents.model_assumptions: Ideal instantaneous output evaluation, including tick zero. Z means the output driver is released, not a resolved bus voltage. External pull-ups, contention, electrical load, propagation delay and other device features are outside scope.
